example.en: Many people yearn for a free and carefree life.

example.zh: 他一点也不小气，总是请大家吃饭。
example.pinyin: Tā yìdiǎn yě bù xiǎoqì, zǒngshì qǐng dàjiā chīfàn.
example.en: He's not stingy at all; he always treats everyone to meals.

example.zh: 她脸上总是挂着灿烂的笑容。
example.pinyin: Tā liǎn shàng zǒngshì guà zhe cànlàn de xiàoróng.
example.en: She always wears a bright smile on her face.

example.zh: 她抱着自己心爱的小猫。
example.pinyin: Tā bào zhe zìjǐ xīn'ài de xiǎo māo.
example.en: She is holding her beloved little cat.

meaning_en: bottom of one's heart; deep down

example.zh: 她心底里一直惦记着家乡。
example.pinyin: Tā xīndǐ lǐ yìzhí diànjì zhe jiāxiāng.
example.en: In her heart, she always misses her hometown.

example.zh: 音乐可以净化人的心灵。
example.pinyin: Yīnyuè kěyǐ jìnghuà rén de xīnlíng.
example.en: Music can purify the soul.

example.zh: 他在大家心目中是一个好人。
example.pinyin: Tā zài dàjiā xīnmù zhōng shì yí ge hǎo rén.
example.en: He is a good person in everyone's eyes.

meaning_en: to feel sorry for; to love dearly

example.zh: 妈妈看到孩子受伤了非常心疼。
example.pinyin: Māma kàn dào háizi shòushāng le fēicháng xīnténg.
example.en: Mom felt very distressed seeing her child hurt.

example.zh: 他终于实现了多年的心愿。
example.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú shíxiàn le duō nián de xīnyuàn.
example.en: He finally fulfilled his long-held wish.

example.zh: 这个品牌深受消费者的信赖。
example.pinyin: Zhège pǐnpái shēn shòu xiāofèizhě de xìnlài.
example.en: This brand is deeply trusted by consumers.

example.zh: 坚定的信念是成功的关键。
example.pinyin: Jiāndìng de xìnniàn shì chénggōng de guānjiàn.
example.en: Firm belief is the key to success.

example.zh: 父亲对他的要求非常严厉。
example.pinyin: Fùqīn duì tā de yāoqiú fēicháng yánlì.
example.en: His father's demands on him are very strict.

example.zh: 她看人的眼光很准。
example.pinyin: Tā kàn rén de yǎnguāng hěn zhǔn.
example.en: She has a keen eye for judging people.

meaning_en: to rely on; to depend on

example.zh: 我们不能过度依赖电子设备。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng guòdù yīlài diànzǐ shèbèi.
example.en: We shouldn't rely too much on electronic devices.

example.zh: 他心中充满了疑惑。
example.pinyin: Tā xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le yíhuò.
example.en: He was full of doubt in his heart.

example.zh: 阅读对个人成长有很多益处。
example.pinyin: Yuèdú duì gèrén chéngzhǎng yǒu hěn duō yìchù.
example.en: Reading has many benefits for personal growth.

meaning_en: to be brave in; to dare to

example.zh: 年轻人要勇于面对挑战。
example.pinyin: Niánqīngrén yào yǒngyú miànduì tiǎozhàn.
example.en: Young people should be brave in facing challenges.

example.zh: 她用心准备了这次演讲。
example.pinyin: Tā yòngxīn zhǔnbèi le zhè cì yǎnjiǎng.
example.en: She prepared this speech with great care.

example.zh: 他今天干活儿特别有劲。
example.pinyin: Tā jīntiān gànhuór tèbié yǒujìn.
example.en: He is especially energetic working today.

example.zh: 人的欲望是无止境的。
example.pinyin: Rén de yùwàng shì wú zhǐjìng de.
example.en: Human desires are endless.

example.zh: 他不太在意别人的看法。
example.pinyin: Tā bú tài zàiyì biéren de kànfǎ.
example.en: He doesn't care much about other people's opinions.

example.zh: 他的演讲受到了大家的赞赏。
example.pinyin: Tā de yǎnjiǎng shòudào le dàjiā de zànshǎng.
example.en: His speech was appreciated by everyone.

example.zh: 我完全赞同你的观点。
example.pinyin: Wǒ wánquán zàntóng nǐ de guāndiǎn.
example.en: I completely agree with your point of view.

example.zh: 邻居之间不应该经常争吵。
example.pinyin: Línjū zhījiān bù yīnggāi jīngcháng zhēngchǎo.
example.en: Neighbors should not argue frequently.

example.zh: 他的研究结果受到了同行的质疑。
example.pinyin: Tā de yánjiū jiéguǒ shòudào le tóngháng de zhìyí.
example.en: His research results were questioned by peers.

meaning_en: blessing; to bless; to wish well

example.zh: 我送上最真诚的祝福。
example.pinyin: Wǒ sòng shàng zuì zhēnchéng de zhùfú.
example.en: I send my most sincere blessings.

meaning_en: to wish; to express good wishes

example.zh: 衷心祝愿你们幸福美满。
example.pinyin: Zhōngxīn zhùyuàn nǐmen xìngfú měimǎn.
example.en: I sincerely wish you happiness and fulfillment.

example.zh: 他非常专注地写作。
example.pinyin: Tā fēicháng zhuānzhù de xiězuò.
example.en: He writes with great concentration.

example.zh: 他为自己的成就感到自豪。
example.pinyin: Tā wèi zìjǐ de chéngjiù gǎndào zìháo.
example.en: He is proud of his achievements.

example.zh: 成功的人通常都非常自律。
example.pinyin: Chénggōng de rén tōngcháng dōu fēicháng zìlǜ.
example.en: Successful people are usually very self-disciplined.

meaning_en: to talk to oneself; to mutter

example.zh: 他走在路上自言自语。
example.pinyin: Tā zǒu zài lù shàng zìyán-zìyǔ.
example.en: He was talking to himself while walking.

example.zh: 参加这个活动完全是自愿的。
example.pinyin: Cānjiā zhège huódòng wánquán shì zìyuàn de.
example.en: Participation in this activity is completely voluntary.

example.zh: 她用眼神暗示我不要说话。
example.pinyin: Tā yòng yǎnshén ànshì wǒ bú yào shuōhuà.
example.en: She hinted with her eyes for me to stay quiet.

meaning_en: to break free from; to get rid of

example.zh: 他终于摆脱了贫困的生活。
example.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú bǎituō le pínkùn de shēnghuó.
example.en: He finally broke free from a life of poverty.

meaning_en: to accompany; to go along with

example.zh: 伴随着音乐，大家跳起了舞。
example.pinyin: Bànsuí zhe yīnyuè, dàjiā tiào qǐ le wǔ.
example.en: Accompanied by the music, everyone started dancing.

meaning_en: to keep; to take care of; to safeguard

example.zh: 请你保管好自己的贵重物品。
example.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎoguǎn hǎo zìjǐ de guìzhòng wùpǐn.
example.en: Please take good care of your valuables.

meaning_en: to burst; to explode; to pop

example.zh: 气球突然爆了。
example.pinyin: Qìqiú tūrán bào le.
example.en: The balloon suddenly burst.

example.zh: 那座火山随时可能爆发。
example.pinyin: Nà zuò huǒshān suíshí kěnéng bàofā.
example.en: That volcano could erupt at any time.

example.zh: 这个问题暴露了管理上的漏洞。
example.pinyin: Zhège wèntí bàolù le guǎnlǐ shàng de lòudòng.
example.en: This issue exposed loopholes in management.

example.zh: 远处传来一声巨大的爆炸声。
example.pinyin: Yuǎnchù chuánlái yì shēng jùdà de bàozhà shēng.
example.en: A huge explosion was heard from the distance.

meaning_en: to be forced; to be compelled

example.zh: 他被迫放弃了自己的计划。
example.pinyin: Tā bèipò fàngqì le zìjǐ de jìhuà.
example.en: He was forced to give up his plan.

example.zh: 孩子们在草地上快乐地奔跑。
example.pinyin: Háizimen zài cǎodì shàng kuàilè de bēnpǎo.
example.en: Children are happily running on the grass.

meaning_en: to force; to compel; to press

example.zh: 别逼我做不想做的事情。
example.pinyin: Bié bī wǒ zuò bù xiǎng zuò de shìqing.
example.en: Don't force me to do things I don't want to do.

example.zh: 请把眼睛闭上休息一会儿。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yǎnjing bì shàng xiūxi yíhuìr.
example.en: Please close your eyes and rest for a moment.

meaning_en: to avoid; to evade; to take shelter

example.zh: 遇到危险要及时躲避。
example.pinyin: Yù dào wéixiǎn yào jíshí duǒbì.
example.en: When encountering danger, take shelter in time.

example.zh: 他不顾危险，跳进水里救人。
example.pinyin: Tā búgù wéixiǎn, tiào jìn shuǐ lǐ jiù rén.
example.en: He disregarded the danger and jumped into the water to save someone.

example.zh: 大家对结果进行了各种猜测。
example.pinyin: Dàjiā duì jiéguǒ jìnxíng le gè zhǒng cāicè.
example.en: Everyone made various guesses about the result.

example.zh: 小心，不要踩到地上的水。
example.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, bú yào cǎi dào dì shàng de shuǐ.
example.en: Be careful, don't step on the water on the floor.

example.zh: 领导采纳了他提出的建议。
example.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo cǎinà le tā tíchū de jiànyì.
example.en: The leadership adopted his suggestion.

example.zh: 他的成绩已经超越了所有对手。
example.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì yǐjīng chāoyuè le suǒyǒu duìshǒu.
example.en: His results have surpassed all competitors.

meaning_en: to withdraw; to retract; to recall

example.zh: 他决定撤回之前提交的申请。
example.pinyin: Tā juédìng chèhuí zhīqián tíjiāo de shēnqǐng.
example.en: He decided to withdraw the previously submitted application.

meaning_en: to prop up; to support; to hold up

example.zh: 他撑着一把雨伞走在路上。
example.pinyin: Tā chēng zhe yì bǎ yǔsǎn zǒu zài lù shàng.
example.en: He walked along the road holding an umbrella.

meaning_en: to be called; to be known as

example.zh: 这种植物被称作'沙漠之花'。
example.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng zhíwù bèi chēngzuò 'shāmò zhī huā'.
example.en: This plant is called the 'Desert Flower'.

meaning_en: to present; to appear; to emerge

example.zh: 这幅画呈现出一种宁静的美感。
example.pinyin: Zhè fú huà chéngxiàn chū yì zhǒng níngjìng de měigǎn.
example.en: This painting presents a serene sense of beauty.

meaning_en: to pound; to impact; to assault

example.zh: 这次金融危机对经济造成了巨大冲击。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì jīnróng wēijī duì jīngjì zàochéng le jùdà chōngjī.
example.en: This financial crisis had a huge impact on the economy.

example.zh: 地震后，城市开始重建。
example.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu, chéngshì kāishǐ chóngjiàn.
example.en: After the earthquake, the city began rebuilding.

meaning_en: to exert oneself; to contribute effort

example.zh: 大家都愿意为这件事出力。
example.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu yuànyì wèi zhè jiàn shì chūlì.
example.en: Everyone is willing to contribute effort to this matter.

meaning_en: to show; to produce; to present

example.zh: 请出示您的身份证。
example.pinyin: Qǐng chūshì nín de shēnfènzhèng.
example.en: Please show your ID card.

meaning_en: to convey; to pass on; to relay

example.zh: 请把会议精神传达给每一位同事。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ huìyì jīngshén chuándá gěi měi yí wèi tóngshì.
example.en: Please convey the spirit of the meeting to every colleague.

meaning_en: to rush; to charge; to barge in

example.zh: 他一个人闯进了那间房子。
example.pinyin: Tā yí ge rén chuǎng jìn le nà jiān fángzi.
example.en: He barged into that house all by himself.

example.zh: 玫瑰花的茎上有很多刺。
example.pinyin: Méiguihuā de jīng shàng yǒu hěn duō cì.
example.en: Rose stems have many thorns.

meaning_en: to match; to pair up; to arrange in combination

example.zh: 这件外套和裙子搭配得很好看。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào hé qúnzi dāpèi de hěn hǎokàn.
example.en: This jacket goes very well with the skirt.

example.zh: 我们会尽快给您答复。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen huì jǐnkuài gěi nín dáfù.
example.en: We will reply to you as soon as possible.

meaning_en: to strike; to hit; to attack

example.zh: 这次失败对他的信心打击很大。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì shībài duì tā de xìnxīn dǎjī hěn dà.
example.en: This failure was a great blow to his confidence.

meaning_en: to wait; to stay; to treat

example.zh: 你先在这里待一会儿。
example.pinyin: Nǐ xiān zài zhèlǐ dài yíhuìr.
example.en: Please wait here for a while.

example.zh: 老师带领学生们参观了工厂。
example.pinyin: Lǎoshī dàilǐng xuéshēngmen cānguān le gōngchǎng.
example.en: The teacher led the students on a factory tour.

meaning_en: to delay; to hold up; to waste time

example.zh: 路上堵车，耽误了不少时间。
example.pinyin: Lù shàng dǔchē, dānwu le bù shǎo shíjiān.
example.en: Traffic jams on the road delayed a lot of time.

meaning_en: to be born; to come into being

example.zh: 一个伟大的发明就此诞生了。
example.pinyin: Yí ge wěidà de fāmíng jiùcǐ dànshēng le.
example.en: A great invention was thus born.

meaning_en: to learn of; to find out

example.zh: 他得知消息后立刻赶了过来。
example.pinyin: Tā dézhī xiāoxi hòu lìkè gǎn le guòlái.
example.en: He rushed over immediately upon learning the news.

example.zh: 人体的免疫系统可以抵抗病毒。
example.pinyin: Réntǐ de miǎnyì xìtǒng kěyǐ dǐkàng bìngdú.
example.en: The human immune system can resist viruses.

example.zh: 他点燃了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。
example.pinyin: Tā diǎnrán le shēngrì dàngāo shàng de làzhú.
example.en: He lit the candles on the birthday cake.

meaning_en: to hang; to hoist; to suspend

example.zh: 工人用绳子把重物吊了上去。
example.pinyin: Gōngrén yòng shéngzi bǎ zhòngwù diào le shàngqù.
example.en: Workers hoisted the heavy object up with a rope.

meaning_en: to carry (with both hands); to hold level; end

example.zh: 他双手端着一碗热汤走了过来。
example.pinyin: Tā shuāng shǒu duān zhe yì wǎn rè tāng zǒu le guòlái.
example.en: He walked over carrying a bowl of hot soup with both hands.

example.zh: 他蹲在地上修理自行车。
example.pinyin: Tā dūn zài dì shàng xiūlǐ zìxíngchē.
example.en: He squatted on the ground to repair the bicycle.

meaning_en: to dodge; to avoid; to take shelter

example.zh: 人们纷纷跑进屋里躲避暴风雨。
example.pinyin: Rénmen fēnfēn pǎo jìn wū lǐ duǒbì bàofēngyǔ.
example.en: People hurried into the house to take shelter from the storm.

meaning_en: to start; to launch; to mobilize

example.zh: 司机发动了汽车的引擎。
example.pinyin: Sījī fādòng le qìchē de yǐnqíng.
example.en: The driver started the car engine.

meaning_en: to hinder; to impede; to obstruct

example.zh: 请不要妨碍其他人的正常工作。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào fáng'ài qítā rén de zhèngcháng gōngzuò.
example.en: Please don't interfere with other people's normal work.

meaning_en: scattered; dispersed; to disperse; to distribute

example.zh: 不要分散注意力。
example.pinyin: Bú yào fēnsàn zhùyìlì.
example.en: Don't let your attention wander.

meaning_en: to seal off; to close; to confine

example.zh: 这条路因为施工被封闭了。
example.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù yīnwèi shīgōng bèi fēngbì le.
example.en: This road is closed due to construction.

example.zh: 大雪覆盖了整个城市。
example.pinyin: Dà xuě fùgài le zhěnggè chéngshì.
example.en: Heavy snow covered the entire city.

meaning_en: to endow; to give; to entrust

example.zh: 法律赋予了公民选举权。
example.pinyin: Fǎlǜ fùyǔ le gōngmín xuǎnjǔquán.
example.en: The law grants citizens the right to vote.

meaning_en: to transform; to remodel; to reform

example.zh: 老旧小区正在进行改造。
example.pinyin: Lǎojiù xiǎoqū zhèngzài jìnxíng gǎizào.
example.en: The old residential area is undergoing renovation.

example.zh: 请不要干扰其他考生答题。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào gānrǎo qítā kǎoshēng dátí.
example.en: Please don't disturb other examinees while they answer.

meaning_en: to infect; to influence; to affect

example.zh: 他的热情感染了在场的每一个人。
example.pinyin: Tā de rèqíng gǎnrǎn le zàichǎng de měi yí ge rén.
example.en: His enthusiasm infected everyone present.

meaning_en: to cut; to reap; to harvest

example.zh: 农民正在田里割麦子。
example.pinyin: Nóngmín zhèngzài tián lǐ gē màizi.
example.en: Farmers are harvesting wheat in the field.

meaning_en: to give; to grant; to render

example.zh: 老师给予了他很大的鼓励。
example.pinyin: Lǎoshī jǐyǔ le tā hěn dà de gǔlì.
example.en: The teacher gave him great encouragement.

example.zh: 小狗一直跟随着主人。
example.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu yìzhí gēnsuí zhe zhǔrén.
example.en: The puppy keeps following its owner.

meaning_en: to follow; to track; to tail

example.zh: 记者跟踪报道了这起事件。
example.pinyin: Jìzhě gēnzōng bàodào le zhè qǐ shìjiàn.
example.en: The journalist followed up on and reported this incident.

example.zh: 不要用语言攻击别人。
example.pinyin: Bú yào yòng yǔyán gōngjī biéren.
example.en: Don't attack others with words.

example.zh: 我们需要巩固已经取得的成果。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào gǒnggù yǐjīng qǔdé de chéngguǒ.
example.en: We need to consolidate the achievements already made.

example.zh: 这座桥梁的构造非常精巧。
example.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáoliáng de gòuzào fēicháng jīngqiǎo.
example.en: The structure of this bridge is very ingenious.

meaning_en: to attend to; to take care of; to look after

example.zh: 他忙得顾不上吃饭。
example.pinyin: Tā máng de gù bu shàng chīfàn.
example.en: He was so busy he couldn't even eat.

meaning_en: to connect; to relate; to be related

example.zh: 这两件事之间有密切的关联。
example.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiàn shì zhījiān yǒu mìqiè de guānlián.
example.en: There is a close connection between these two matters.

meaning_en: to return; to belong to; to revert to

example.zh: 在外漂泊多年，他终于归乡了。
example.pinyin: Zài wài piāobó duō nián, tā zhōngyú guī xiāng le.
example.en: After wandering for many years, he finally returned home.

example.zh: 借的书请按时归还图书馆。
example.pinyin: Jiè de shū qǐng ànshí guīhuán túshūguǎn.
example.en: Please return the borrowed books to the library on time.

example.zh: 这只是一个过渡阶段。
example.pinyin: Zhè zhǐ shì yí ge guòdù jiēduàn.
example.en: This is just a transitional phase.

meaning_en: to measure; to weigh; to judge

example.zh: 不能只用成绩来衡量一个学生。
example.pinyin: Bù néng zhǐ yòng chéngjì lái héngliáng yí ge xuéshēng.
example.en: You can't measure a student solely by their grades.

example.zh: 遇到困难不能后退。
example.pinyin: Yù dào kùnnán bù néng hòutuì.
example.en: Don't retreat when facing difficulties.

meaning_en: to neglect; to overlook; to ignore

example.zh: 我们不能忽略细节。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen bù néng hūlüè xìjié.
example.en: We cannot overlook the details.

meaning_en: to divide; to partition; to differentiate

example.zh: 这本书按照主题划分为十个章节。
example.pinyin: Zhè běn shū ànzhào zhǔtí huàfēn wéi shí ge zhāngjié.
example.en: This book is divided into ten chapters by topic.

meaning_en: to restore; to reduce; to return to original state

example.zh: 科学家正在试图还原历史事件的真相。
example.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài shìtú huányuán lìshǐ shìjiàn de zhēnxiàng.

example.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué yǒngyǒu yīliú de shīzī lìliàng.
example.en: This university has first-class faculty.

example.zh: 他一贯做事认真负责。
example.pinyin: Tā yíguàn zuòshì rènzhēn fùzé.
example.en: He has always been serious and responsible in his work.

example.zh: 今天的天气异常寒冷。
example.pinyin: Jīntiān de tiānqì yìcháng hánlěng.
example.en: Today's weather is unusually cold.

example.zh: 这两个杯子长得一模一样。
example.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge bēizi zhǎng de yìmú-yíyàng.
example.en: These two cups look exactly the same.

example.zh: 这个东西看起来没什么用处。
example.pinyin: Zhège dōngxi kàn qǐlái méi shénme yòngchù.
example.en: This thing doesn't seem to have much use.

example.zh: 她以优异的成绩毕业了。
example.pinyin: Tā yǐ yōuyì de chéngjì bìyè le.
example.en: She graduated with outstanding grades.

example.zh: 疏散工作进行得非常有序。
example.pinyin: Shūsàn gōngzuò jìnxíng de fēicháng yǒuxù.
example.en: The evacuation was carried out in a very orderly manner.

example.zh: 这次活动取得了圆满成功。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng qǔdé le yuánmǎn chénggōng.
example.en: This event achieved complete success.

example.zh: 他的桌子上东西太杂了。
example.pinyin: Tā de zhuōzi shàng dōngxi tài zá le.
example.en: There are too many miscellaneous things on his desk.

example.zh: 她穿了一件崭新的裙子。
example.pinyin: Tā chuān le yí jiàn zhǎnxīn de qúnzi.
example.en: She wore a brand-new dress.

example.zh: 你应该去正规的医院看病。
example.pinyin: Nǐ yīnggāi qù zhèngguī de yīyuàn kànbìng.
example.en: You should go to a regular hospital to see a doctor.

example.zh: 我们要多从正面的角度看问题。
example.pinyin: Wǒmen yào duō cóng zhèngmiàn de jiǎodù kàn wèntí.
example.en: We should look at problems more from a positive perspective.

example.zh: 他的成绩属于中等水平。
example.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì shǔyú zhōngděng shuǐpíng.
example.en: His grades are at an average level.

example.zh: 酒店的服务非常周到。
example.pinyin: Jiǔdiàn de fúwù fēicháng zhōudào.
example.en: The hotel's service is very considerate.

example.zh: 这个项目面临诸多挑战。
example.pinyin: Zhège xiàngmù miànlín zhūduō tiǎozhàn.
example.en: This project faces many challenges.

meaning_en: enough; ample; as much as; fully

example.zh: 时间足够的话，我们可以多参观几个地方。
example.pinyin: Shíjiān zú gòu de huà, wǒmen kěyǐ duō cānguān jǐ ge dìfang.
example.en: If there's enough time, we can visit a few more places.

example.zh: 这么好的机会不能白白浪费。
example.pinyin: Zhème hǎo de jīhuì bù néng báibái làngfèi.
example.en: Such a good opportunity should not be wasted for nothing.

example.zh: 这些年来，他不曾回过家乡。
example.pinyin: Zhèxiē nián lái, tā bùcéng huí guò jiāxiāng.
example.en: Over the years, he has never returned to his hometown.

meaning_en: side; to lean; to turn sideways

example.zh: 请从侧门进入。
example.pinyin: Qǐng cóng cè mén jìnrù.
example.en: Please enter from the side door.

example.zh: 趁天还没黑，我们赶紧出发吧。
example.pinyin: Chèn tiān hái méi hēi, wǒmen gǎnjǐn chūfā ba.
example.en: Let's hurry and set off before it gets dark.

meaning_en: towards; to face; to rush; powerful

example.zh: 他冲着我大声喊了一句。
example.pinyin: Tā chòng zhe wǒ dàshēng hǎn le yí jù.
example.en: He shouted loudly at me.

example.zh: 春天来了，处处鸟语花香。
example.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, chùchù niǎoyǔ huāxiāng.
example.en: Spring has come, with birdsong and floral fragrance everywhere.

example.zh: 我从未去过那个地方。
example.pinyin: Wǒ cóngwèi qù guò nàge dìfang.
example.en: I have never been to that place.

example.zh: 参加会议的人大都是专家学者。
example.pinyin: Cānjiā huìyì de rén dàdū shì zhuānjiā xuézhě.
example.en: Most of the attendees at the meeting were experts and scholars.

example.zh: 今年的销售额大幅增长。
example.pinyin: Jīnnián de xiāoshòu'é dàfú zēngzhǎng.
example.en: This year's sales volume has increased significantly.

example.zh: 情况大致就是这样。
example.pinyin: Qíngkuàng dàzhì jiù shì zhèyàng.
example.en: The situation is roughly like this.

meaning_en: on the spot; then and there

example.zh: 他当场就签了合同。
example.pinyin: Tā dāngchǎng jiù qiān le hétong.
example.en: He signed the contract on the spot.

meaning_en: to one's face; face to face

example.zh: 有意见最好当面说清楚。
example.pinyin: Yǒu yìjiàn zuìhǎo dāngmiàn shuō qīngchǔ.
example.en: It's best to express opinions face to face.

example.zh: 听到好消息，他顿时高兴起来。
example.pinyin: Tīng dào hǎo xiāoxi, tā dùnshí gāoxìng qǐlái.
example.en: Upon hearing the good news, he immediately became happy.

example.zh: 指南针可以帮助我们辨别方位。
example.pinyin: Zhǐnánzhēn kěyǐ bāngzhù wǒmen biànbié fāngwèi.
example.en: A compass can help us determine direction.

example.zh: 近年来科技飞速发展。
example.pinyin: Jìnnián lái kējì fēisù fāzhǎn.
example.en: Technology has developed rapidly in recent years.

example.zh: 看到老人摔倒了，他赶忙跑过去扶。
example.pinyin: Kàn dào lǎorén shuāi dǎo le, tā gǎnmáng pǎo guòqù fú.
example.en: Seeing the old man fall, he hurried over to help.

example.zh: 小猫跑到他跟前来了。
example.pinyin: Xiǎo māo pǎo dào tā gēnqián lái le.
example.en: The kitten ran up to him.

meaning_en: not in the least; without any

example.zh: 他毫不犹豫地答应了。
example.pinyin: Tā háobù yóuyù de dāyìng le.
example.en: He agreed without any hesitation.

example.zh: 他对这件事毫无兴趣。
example.pinyin: Tā duì zhè jiàn shì háowú xìngqù.
example.en: He has absolutely no interest in this matter.

example.zh: 经过一番努力，好不容易才完成了。
example.pinyin: Jīngguò yì fān nǔlì, hǎobù róngyì cái wánchéng le.
example.en: After much effort, it was finally completed with great difficulty.

example.zh: 我好容易才找到一份工作。
example.pinyin: Wǒ hǎo róngyì cái zhǎo dào yí fèn gōngzuò.
example.en: I finally managed to find a job with great difficulty.

example.zh: 路上横着一棵倒下的大树。
example.pinyin: Lù shàng héng zhe yì kē dǎo xià de dà shù.
example.en: A fallen tree lay across the road.

meaning_en: to turn one's head; later; otherwise

example.zh: 他回头看了一眼。
example.pinyin: Tā huítóu kàn le yì yǎn.
example.en: He turned back and glanced.

example.zh: 这件事极为重要。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì jíwéi zhòngyào.
example.en: This matter is extremely important.

example.zh: 他加倍努力，终于考上了大学。
example.pinyin: Tā jiābèi nǔlì, zhōngyú kǎo shàng le dàxué.
example.en: He doubled his efforts and finally got into college.

example.zh: 这个方案较为可行。
example.pinyin: Zhège fāng'àn jiàowéi kěxíng.
example.en: This plan is relatively feasible.

example.zh: 最近接连发生了好几起交通事故。
example.pinyin: Zuìjìn jiēlián fāshēng le hǎo jǐ qǐ jiāotōng shìgù.
example.en: Several traffic accidents have occurred in succession recently.

example.zh: 他明明知道答案，却不肯说。
example.pinyin: Tā míngmíng zhīdào dá'àn, què bù kěn shuō.
example.en: He clearly knows the answer but refuses to say it.

example.zh: 她默默地支持着他的事业。
example.pinyin: Tā mòmò de zhīchí zhe tā de shìyè.
example.en: She silently supports his career.

meaning_en: inside and outside; domestic and foreign

example.zh: 这件事需要内外共同配合。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì xūyào nèiwài gòngtóng pèihé.
example.en: This matter requires coordination both internally and externally.

example.zh: 我到的时候，他恰好也在。
example.pinyin: Wǒ dào de shíhou, tā qiàhǎo yě zài.
example.en: When I arrived, he happened to be there too.

example.zh: 恰恰相反，事实并非如此。
example.pinyin: Qiàqià xiāngfǎn, shìshí bìng fēi rúcǐ.
example.en: On the contrary, the fact is not so.

example.zh: 多年过去了，他仍旧住在原来的地方。
example.pinyin: Duō nián guòqù le, tā réngjiù zhù zài yuánlái de dìfang.
example.en: Many years have passed, but he still lives in the same place.

example.zh: 环境问题日益严重。
example.pinyin: Huánjìng wèntí rìyì yánzhòng.
example.en: Environmental problems are becoming increasingly serious.

example.zh: 请把这根杆子竖起来。
example.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zhè gēn gānzi shù qǐlái.
example.en: Please stand this pole upright.

example.zh: 这家公司率先推出了新技术。
example.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī shuàixiān tuīchū le xīn jìshù.
example.en: This company took the lead in launching the new technology.

example.zh: 这种鸟特好看。
example.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng niǎo tè hǎokàn.
example.en: This kind of bird is especially beautiful.

example.zh: 他特地从上海赶来参加婚礼。
example.pinyin: Tā tèdì cóng Shànghǎi gǎn lái cānjiā hūnlǐ.
example.en: He came specially from Shanghai to attend the wedding.

example.zh: 她特意为他准备了一份礼物。
example.pinyin: Tā tèyì wèi tā zhǔnbèi le yí fèn lǐwù.
example.en: She specially prepared a gift for him.

meaning_en: to get close to; close to

example.zh: 这部电影的故事贴近现实生活。
example.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de gùshi tiējìn xiànshí shēnghuó.
example.en: The story of this movie is close to real life.

example.zh: 他偷偷地看了她一眼。
example.pinyin: Tā tōutōu de kàn le tā yì yǎn.
example.en: He secretly glanced at her.

example.zh: 透过窗户可以看到远处的山。
example.pinyin: Tòuguò chuānghu kěyǐ kàn dào yuǎnchù de shān.
example.en: You can see the mountains in the distance through the window.

example.zh: 这个计划尚未得到批准。
example.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà shàng wèi dédào pīzhǔn.
example.en: This plan has not yet been approved.

example.zh: 他说的话未必都是真的。
example.pinyin: Tā shuō de huà wèibì dōu shì zhēn de.
example.en: What he says may not all be true.

meaning_en: soon; in the blink of an eye; to watch helplessly

example.zh: 眼看就要迟到了，他赶紧叫了辆出租车。
example.pinyin: Yǎnkàn jiù yào chídào le, tā gǎnjǐn jiào le liàng chūzūchē.
example.en: Seeing he was about to be late, he quickly hailed a taxi.

example.zh: 多年过去了，她依旧那么美丽。
example.pinyin: Duō nián guòqù le, tā yījiù nàme měilì.
example.en: Many years have passed, but she is still just as beautiful.

meaning_en: one by one; one after another

example.zh: 老师一一解答了学生的问题。
example.pinyin: Lǎoshī yīyī jiědá le xuéshēng de wèntí.
example.en: The teacher answered the students' questions one by one.

example.zh: 他们一道去了博物馆。
example.pinyin: Tāmen yídào qù le bówùguǎn.
example.en: They went to the museum together.

example.zh: 所有员工一律不得迟到。
example.pinyin: Suǒyǒu yuángōng yílǜ bù dé chídào.
example.en: All employees are required without exception not to be late.

example.zh: 她一向对人很友善。
example.pinyin: Tā yíxiàng duì rén hěn yǒushàn.
example.en: She has always been friendly to people.

example.zh: 医生一再叮嘱他要注意休息。
example.pinyin: Yīshēng yízài dīngzhǔ tā yào zhùyì xiūxi.
example.en: The doctor repeatedly urged him to rest.

example.zh: 他一口气跑了三公里。
example.pinyin: Tā yìkǒuqì pǎo le sān gōnglǐ.
example.en: He ran three kilometers in one breath.

example.zh: 他们一同参加了志愿者活动。
example.pinyin: Tāmen yìtóng cānjiā le zhìyuànzhě huódòng.
example.en: They participated in the volunteer activity together.

example.zh: 这座桥建于清代。
example.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo jiàn yú Qīng dài.
example.en: This bridge was built during the Qing Dynasty.

example.zh: 他原本打算坐火车去，后来改了主意。
example.pinyin: Tā yuánběn dǎsuàn zuò huǒchē qù, hòulái gǎi le zhǔyì.
example.en: He originally planned to go by train but changed his mind.

example.zh: 他再三强调安全的重要性。
example.pinyin: Tā zàisān qiángdiào ānquán de zhòngyàoxìng.
example.en: He repeatedly emphasized the importance of safety.

meaning_en: to have no choice but to; to have to

example.zh: 下雨了，我们只得取消了户外活动。
example.pinyin: Xià yǔ le, wǒmen zhǐdé qǔxiāo le hùwài huódòng.
example.en: It rained, so we had no choice but to cancel the outdoor activity.

meaning_en: to be absorbed in; only concerned with

example.zh: 他只顾着玩手机，忘了做作业。
example.pinyin: Tā zhǐgù zhe wán shǒujī, wàng le zuò zuòyè.
example.en: He was so absorbed in playing with his phone that he forgot to do his homework.

example.zh: 公司决定把工作重心转移到研发上。
example.pinyin: Gōngsī juédìng bǎ gōngzuò zhòngxīn zhuǎnyí dào yánfā shàng.
example.en: The company decided to shift its focus to R&D.

meaning_en: finally; at long last; in the end

example.zh: 经过长时间的等待，他总算拿到了签证。
example.pinyin: Jīngguò cháng shíjiān de děngdài, tā zǒngsuàn ná dào le qiānzhèng.
example.en: After a long wait, he finally got the visa.

example.zh: 人们对健康食品的需求倍增。
example.pinyin: Rénmen duì jiànkāng shípǐn de xūqiú bèizēng.
example.en: The demand for healthy food has doubled.

example.zh: 服务业在经济中的比重越来越大。
example.pinyin: Fúwùyè zài jīngjì zhōng de bǐzhòng yuèláiyuè dà.
example.en: The proportion of the service industry in the economy is growing.

example.zh: 这两根绳子的长短不一样。
example.pinyin: Zhè liǎng gēn shéngzi de chángduǎn bù yíyàng.
example.en: The lengths of these two ropes are different.

meaning_en: ten percent; one tenth; to become; to succeed

example.zh: 他把工资的三成存了起来。
example.pinyin: Tā bǎ gōngzī de sān chéng cún le qǐlái.
example.en: He saved thirty percent of his salary.

meaning_en: to multiply; to ride; to take advantage of

example.zh: 五乘二等于十。
example.pinyin: Wǔ chéng èr děngyú shí.
example.en: Five times two equals ten.

meaning_en: tens of thousands; thousands upon thousands

example.zh: 成千上万的游客来到这里参观。
example.pinyin: Chéngqiān-shàngwàn de yóukè lái dào zhèlǐ cānguān.
example.en: Tens of thousands of tourists came here to visit.

example.zh: 这块木板大约有三尺长。
example.pinyin: Zhè kuài mùbǎn dàyuē yǒu sān chǐ cháng.
example.en: This plank is about three chi long.

example.zh: 请告诉我您需要的尺寸。
example.pinyin: Qǐng gàosu wǒ nín xūyào de chǐcùn.
example.en: Please tell me the size you need.

example.zh: 她买了一串葡萄。
example.pinyin: Tā mǎi le yí chuàn pútao.
example.en: She bought a bunch of grapes.

example.zh: 他迟到的次数越来越多了。
example.pinyin: Tā chídào de cìshù yuèláiyuè duō le.
example.en: The number of times he has been late is increasing.

example.zh: 他寸步不离地守在孩子身边。
example.pinyin: Tā cùn bù bù lí de shǒu zài háizi shēnbiān.
example.en: He stayed close to the child without leaving for even a step.

example.zh: 小区里新建了三栋高楼。
example.pinyin: Xiǎoqū lǐ xīnjiàn le sān dòng gāolóu.
example.en: Three new tall buildings were built in the residential area.

meaning_en: (measure word for occasions, kinds or processes); time

example.zh: 他把整个报告仔细看了一番。
example.pinyin: Tā bǎ zhěnggè bàogào zǐxì kàn le yì fān.
example.en: He carefully reviewed the entire report.

example.zh: 今年物价上涨的幅度不大。
example.pinyin: Jīnnián wùjià shàngzhǎng de fúdù bú dà.
example.en: The magnitude of price increases this year is not large.

meaning_en: deputy; vice-; secondary; (measure word for pairs or sets)

example.zh: 这副眼镜是新买的。
example.pinyin: Zhè fù yǎnjìng shì xīn mǎi de.
example.en: This pair of glasses was newly bought.

meaning_en: to total; to add up to

example.zh: 这次捐款共计一百万元。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì juānkuǎn gòngjì yìbǎi wàn yuán.
example.en: The total donation amounts to one million yuan.

example.zh: 这根线的直径只有零点五毫米。
example.pinyin: Zhè gēn xiàn de zhíjìng zhǐyǒu líng diǎn wǔ háomǐ.
example.en: The diameter of this wire is only 0.5 millimeters.

example.zh: 每次服用十毫升药水。
example.pinyin: Měi cì fúyòng shí háoshēng yàoshuǐ.
example.en: Take ten milliliters of medicine each time.

example.zh: 这个小区一共有五百户居民。
example.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū yígòng yǒu wǔbǎi hù jūmín.
example.en: This residential area has a total of five hundred households.

meaning_en: grain; (measure word for small round things)

example.zh: 桌上有几粒米饭。
example.pinyin: Zhuō shàng yǒu jǐ lì mǐfàn.
example.en: There are a few grains of rice on the table.

example.zh: 政府加大了对环境保护的力度。
example.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ jiādà le duì huánjìng bǎohù de lìdù.
example.en: The government has increased its efforts in environmental protection.

example.zh: 今年的录取率比去年高了不少。
example.pinyin: Jīnnián de lùqǔ lǜ bǐ qùnián gāo le bù shǎo.
example.en: This year's admission rate is much higher than last year's.

example.zh: 她端来了一盘水果。
example.pinyin: Tā duān lái le yì pán shuǐguǒ.
example.en: She brought a plate of fruit.

example.zh: 三的平方等于九。
example.pinyin: Sān de píngfāng děngyú jiǔ.
example.en: Three squared equals nine.

example.zh: 这套公寓的面积是八十平方米。
example.pinyin: Zhè tào gōngyù de miànjī shì bāshí píngfāngmǐ.
example.en: The area of this apartment is eighty square meters.

example.zh: 请在正确答案上画一个圈。
example.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhèngquè dá'àn shàng huà yí ge quān.
example.en: Please draw a circle around the correct answer.

example.zh: 这个城市的人均收入水平很高。
example.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì de rénjūn shōurù shuǐpíng hěn gāo.
example.en: The per capita income level of this city is very high.

example.zh: 这个U盘的容量是六十四G。
example.pinyin: Zhège U pán de róngliàng shì liùshísì G.
example.en: The capacity of this USB drive is 64 GB.

example.zh: 她手里拿着一把漂亮的折扇。
example.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe yì bǎ piàoliang de zhéshàn.
example.en: She is holding a beautiful folding fan.

meaning_en: liter; to rise; to go up

example.zh: 一升水等于一千毫升。
example.pinyin: Yì shēng shuǐ děngyú yìqiān háoshēng.
example.en: One liter of water equals one thousand milliliters.

example.zh: 参加活动的人数目还在增加。
example.pinyin: Cānjiā huódòng de rén shùmù hái zài zēngjiā.
example.en: The number of participants is still increasing.

example.zh: 港口停着好几艘大型货轮。
example.pinyin: Gǎngkǒu tíng zhe hǎo jǐ sōu dàxíng huòlún.
example.en: Several large cargo ships are docked at the port.

example.zh: 这个箱子的体积太大了。
example.pinyin: Zhège xiāngzi de tǐjī tài dà le.
example.en: The volume of this box is too large.

example.zh: 公司即将推出一系列新产品。
example.pinyin: Gōngsī jíjiāng tuīchū yí xìliè xīn chǎnpǐn.
example.en: The company is about to launch a series of new products.

example.zh: 请在这条线后面排队。
example.pinyin: Qǐng zài zhè tiáo xiàn hòumiàn páiduì.
example.en: Please queue behind this line.

example.zh: 任何事情都有一个限度。
example.pinyin: Rènhé shìqing dōu yǒu yí ge xiàndù.
example.en: Everything has a limit.

meaning_en: to differ by; to be apart

example.zh: 兄弟俩的年龄相差三岁。
example.pinyin: Xiōngdì liǎ de niánlíng xiāngchā sān suì.
example.en: The two brothers are three years apart in age.

meaning_en: to be equal; to be equivalent

example.zh: 这两条线的长度相等。
example.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo xiàn de chángdù xiāngděng.
example.en: The lengths of these two lines are equal.

example.zh: 这幅画是什么样的？
example.pinyin: Zhè fú huà shì shénme yàng de?
example.en: What does this painting look like?

example.zh: 政府出台了一系列新政策。
example.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ chūtái le yí xìliè xīn zhèngcè.
example.en: The government has introduced a series of new policies.

meaning_en: a spell; a burst; a gust

example.zh: 一阵风吹来，树叶纷纷落下。
example.pinyin: Yí zhèn fēng chuī lái, shùyè fēnfēn luòxià.
example.en: A gust of wind blew, and leaves fell one after another.

example.zh: 他穿了一身黑色的西装。
example.pinyin: Tā chuān le yìshēn hēisè de xīzhuāng.
example.en: He wore a full black suit.

example.zh: 新能源汽车的销量占比持续增长。
example.pinyin: Xīn néngyuán qìchē de xiāoliàng zhànbǐ chíxù zēngzhǎng.
example.en: The sales share of new energy vehicles continues to grow.

example.zh: 这本书一共有十二章。
example.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yígòng yǒu shí'èr zhāng.
example.en: This book has twelve chapters in total.

example.zh: 这些商品总计花了两千元。
example.pinyin: Zhèxiē shāngpǐn zǒngjì huā le liǎngqiān yuán.
example.en: These goods cost a total of two thousand yuan.

example.zh: 这个问题本身并不复杂。
example.pinyin: Zhège wèntí běnshēn bìng bù fùzá.
example.en: The problem itself is not complex.

meaning_en: to take as an example; for instance

example.zh: 比方说，我们可以换一种方式。
example.pinyin: Bǐfang shuō, wǒmen kěyǐ huàn yì zhǒng fāngshì.
example.en: For example, we could try a different approach.

example.zh: 他以为很简单，不料却遇到了很多困难。
example.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi hěn jiǎndān, búliào què yù dào le hěn duō kùnnán.
example.en: He thought it would be simple, but unexpectedly encountered many difficulties.

meaning_en: unlikely; not so bad as to

example.zh: 事情不至于那么严重吧？
example.pinyin: Shìqing búzhìyú nàme yánzhòng ba?
example.en: Things shouldn't be that serious, right?

meaning_en: won't do; not work; (used in rhetorical questions)

example.zh: 连这点小事都做不成吗？
example.pinyin: Lián zhè diǎn xiǎo shì dōu zuò bùchéng ma?
example.en: Can't you even get this little thing done?

example.zh: 图书馆里不得大声说话。
example.pinyin: Túshūguǎn lǐ bùdé dàshēng shuōhuà.
example.en: Loud talking is not allowed in the library.

example.zh: 老师说考试的时候不许看手机。
example.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō kǎoshì de shíhou bùxǔ kàn shǒujī.
example.en: The teacher said using phones is not allowed during the exam.

example.zh: 这个地区不宜种植水稻。
example.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùyí zhòngzhí shuǐdào.
example.en: This area is not suitable for growing rice.

meaning_en: not just; more than; to be unable to stop

example.zh: 受伤的人不止一个。
example.pinyin: Shòushāng de rén bùzhǐ yí ge.
example.en: More than one person was injured.

meaning_en: discrepancy; difference; going in and out

example.zh: 这两份报告的数据有些出入。
example.pinyin: Zhè liǎng fèn bàogào de shùjù yǒuxiē chūrù.
example.en: There are some discrepancies in the data between these two reports.

example.zh: 他这样做完全是出于好意。
example.pinyin: Tā zhèyàng zuò wánquán shì chūyú hǎoyì.
example.en: He did this entirely out of good intentions.

meaning_en: to get rid of; except; besides

example.zh: 除了他以外，其他人都到了。
example.pinyin: Chú le tā yǐwài, qítā rén dōu dào le.
example.en: Everyone has arrived except him.

example.zh: 除非你亲自去，否则他不会相信。
example.pinyin: Chúfēi nǐ qīnzì qù, fǒuzé tā bú huì xiāngxìn.
example.en: Unless you go in person, he won't believe it.

example.zh: 大伙儿一起动手，很快就做完了。
example.pinyin: Dàhuǒr yìqǐ dòngshǒu, hěn kuài jiù zuòwán le.
example.en: Everyone pitched in, and it was done quickly.

example.zh: 别人都很紧张，他倒是很镇定。
example.pinyin: Biéren dōu hěn jǐnzhāng, tā dàoshì hěn zhèndìng.
example.en: Everyone else was nervous, but he was quite calm.

meaning_en: enough; all right; that will do

example.zh: 算了算了，得了，别吵了。
example.pinyin: Suàn le suàn le, déle, bié chǎo le.
example.en: Alright alright, enough, stop arguing.

meaning_en: to be able to; so that one can

example.zh: 在大家的帮助下，项目得以顺利完成。
example.pinyin: Zài dàjiā de bāngzhù xià, xiàngmù déyǐ shùnlì wánchéng.
example.en: With everyone's help, the project was successfully completed.

example.zh: 多亏了你的帮助，我才能完成任务。
example.pinyin: Duōkuī le nǐ de bāngzhù, wǒ cái néng wánchéng rènwu.
example.en: Thanks to your help, I was able to complete the task.

example.zh: 凡是参加过培训的人都通过了考试。
example.pinyin: Fánshì cānjiā guò péixùn de rén dōu tōngguò le kǎoshì.
example.en: Everyone who attended the training passed the exam.

example.zh: 这项改革涉及社会的方方面面。
example.pinyin: Zhè xiàng gǎigé shèjí shèhuì de fāngfāngmiànmiàn.
example.en: This reform involves all aspects of society.

meaning_en: this; that; the said; should; ought to

example.zh: 该你上场了。
example.pinyin: Gāi nǐ shàngchǎng le.
example.en: It's your turn to go on.

example.zh: 嘿，你好久没来了！
example.pinyin: Hēi, nǐ hǎo jiǔ méi lái le!
example.en: Hey, you haven't been here for a long time!

example.zh: 两个方案比较之后，我选择了后者。
example.pinyin: Liǎng ge fāng'àn bǐjiào zhīhòu, wǒ xuǎnzé le hòuzhě.
example.en: After comparing the two options, I chose the latter.

example.zh: 即便下雨，比赛也照常进行。
example.pinyin: Jíbiàn xiàyǔ, bǐsài yě zhàocháng jìnxíng.
example.en: Even if it rains, the match will go on as scheduled.

example.zh: 对存在的问题要认真加以解决。
example.pinyin: Duì cúnzài de wèntí yào rènzhēn jiāyǐ jiějué.
example.en: Existing problems should be seriously addressed.

example.zh: 他先学会了基础知识，进而开始独立研究。
example.pinyin: Tā xiān xuéhuì le jīchǔ zhīshi, jìn'ér kāishǐ dúlì yánjiū.
example.en: He first learned the basics, and then began independent research.

example.zh: 就算遇到再大的困难也不能放弃。
example.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yù dào zài dà de kùnnán yě bù néng fàngqì.
example.en: Even if you encounter the greatest difficulty, you must not give up.

example.zh: 他终于考上大学啦！
example.pinyin: Tā zhōngyú kǎo shàng dàxué la!
example.en: He finally got into college!

example.zh: 这次没有人例外，大家都要参加。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì méiyǒu rén lìwài, dàjiā dōu yào cānjiā.
example.en: No one is an exception this time; everyone must participate.

example.zh: 这很简单嘛，不用担心。
example.pinyin: Zhè hěn jiǎndān ma, bú yòng dānxīn.
example.en: This is simple; don't worry.

example.zh: 两个方案相比，我更倾向于前者。
example.pinyin: Liǎng ge fāng'àn xiāngbǐ, wǒ gèng qīngxiàng yú qiánzhě.
example.en: Comparing the two plans, I prefer the former.

example.zh: 人家早就知道了，就你不知道。
example.pinyin: Rénjia zǎo jiù zhīdào le, jiù nǐ bù zhīdào.
example.en: Everyone else already knew; only you didn't.

example.zh: 上述问题已经得到了解决。
example.pinyin: Shàngshù wèntí yǐjīng dédào le jiějué.
example.en: The above-mentioned problems have been resolved.

example.zh: 实话说，这件事确实有点难。
example.pinyin: Shíhuà shuō, zhè jiàn shì quèshí yǒudiǎn nán.
example.en: To be honest, this matter is indeed a bit difficult.

example.zh: 算了，别争了，我们换个话题吧。
example.pinyin: Suàn le, bié zhēng le, wǒmen huàn ge huàtí ba.
example.en: Forget it, stop arguing, let's change the subject.

meaning_en: to be considered as; at last

example.zh: 这次成绩还算是不错。
example.pinyin: Zhè cì chéngjì hái suànshì búcuò.
example.en: This result is considered pretty good.

example.zh: 他虽年轻，却很有经验。
example.pinyin: Tā suī niánqīng, què hěn yǒu jīngyàn.
example.en: Although young, he is very experienced.

example.zh: 这是一所著名的大学。
example.pinyin: Zhè shì yì suǒ zhùmíng de dàxué.
example.en: This is a famous university.

example.zh: 哇，这里的风景真美！
example.pinyin: Wa, zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng zhēn měi!
example.en: Wow, the scenery here is so beautiful!

example.zh: 他犯了一个大错，为此付出了沉重的代价。
example.pinyin: Tā fàn le yí ge dà cuò, wèicǐ fùchū le chénzhòng de dàijià.
example.en: He made a big mistake and paid a heavy price for it.

example.zh: 他为何突然辞职了？
example.pinyin: Tā wèihé tūrán cízhí le?
example.en: Why did he suddenly resign?

example.zh: 他无疑是这个领域最出色的专家。
example.pinyin: Tā wúyí shì zhège lǐngyù zuì chūsè de zhuānjiā.
example.en: He is undoubtedly the most outstanding expert in this field.

example.zh: 要么你来，要么我去，总得有人办这件事。
example.pinyin: Yàome nǐ lái, yàome wǒ qù, zǒng děi yǒu rén bàn zhè jiàn shì.
example.en: Either you come or I go; someone has to handle this.

example.zh: 去也好，不去也好，你自己决定吧。
example.pinyin: Qù yě hǎo, bú qù yě hǎo, nǐ zìjǐ juédìng ba.
example.en: Whether you go or not, decide for yourself.

example.zh: 请提前预约，以便我们做好准备。
example.pinyin: Qǐng tíqián yùyuē, yǐbiàn wǒmen zuò hǎo zhǔnbèi.
example.en: Please make a reservation in advance so that we can prepare.

example.zh: 出门记得带伞，以免被雨淋湿。
example.pinyin: Chūmén jìde dài sǎn, yǐmiǎn bèi yǔ lín shī.
example.en: Remember to bring an umbrella when going out to avoid getting wet.

meaning_en: smooth sailing; (idiom) plain sailing all the way

example.zh: 祝你的事业一帆风顺。
example.pinyin: Zhù nǐ de shìyè yìfān-fēngshùn.
example.en: I wish your career smooth sailing.

meaning_en: because of; due to; owing to

example.zh: 因天气原因，航班取消了。
example.pinyin: Yīn tiānqì yuányīn, hángbān qǔxiāo le.
example.en: The flight was cancelled due to weather.

example.zh: 与其抱怨，不如行动起来。
example.pinyin: Yǔqí bàoyuàn, bùrú xíngdòng qǐlái.
example.en: Rather than complaining, it's better to take action.

example.zh: 如遇问题，则应及时报告。
example.pinyin: Rú yù wèntí, zé yīng jíshí bàogào.
example.en: If problems are encountered, they should be reported promptly.

example.zh: 他之所以成功，是因为坚持不懈。
example.pinyin: Tā zhī suǒyǐ chénggōng, shì yīnwèi jiānchí búxiè.
example.en: The reason he succeeded is because of perseverance.

example.zh: 教育对国家发展至关重要。
example.pinyin: Jiàoyù duì guójiā fāzhǎn zhìguān zhòngyào.
example.en: Education is crucial to national development.

meaning_en: as for; as to; to go so far as

example.zh: 至于具体时间，我们再商量。
example.pinyin: Zhìyú jùtǐ shíjiān, wǒmen zài shāngliang.
example.en: As for the specific time, we'll discuss it further.

meaning_en: as everyone knows; (idiom) it is common knowledge

example.zh: 众所周知，吸烟有害健康。
example.pinyin: Zhòngsuǒ-zhōuzhī, xīyān yǒuhài jiànkāng.
example.en: As everyone knows, smoking is harmful to health.

example.zh: 适当的自我反省有助于成长。
example.pinyin: Shìdàng de zìwǒ fǎnxǐng yǒuzhù yú chéngzhǎng.
example.en: Appropriate self-reflection is helpful for growth.
